newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks open up on bullish electronics.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks open up on bullish electronics.

text.p: Taiwan share prices opened sharply higher on Friday on continued bull run of trendsetting electronics and recent Wall Street rallies, brokers said.
After 15 minutes at 0115 GMT, the benchmark stock index was up 103 points or 1.07 percent at 9,735.50.
Turnover was a brisk T$39.6 billion.
"Heavy buy-in was seen in technology shares, with Acer Sertek quickly rising to its seven-percent daily limit," said Lei Pai-yu of Pacific Securities.
Acer Sertek, which went ex-bonus issue on Friday, was up T$6.5 to T$99.
Bellwether electronics were sharply up 4.02 percent to become the sector to carry the market, brokers said.
Brokers said recent rallies in Wall Street also fuelled the bullish sentiment in early trade.
